easy.def: A wild goat with big curved horns.

more.def: A wild mountain goat with long, curved horns.
examples: An ibex stood on the cliff.
The ibex has big curved horns.

easy.def: A wading bird with a long, curved bill.
examples: The ibis has a long bill.

more.def: A wading bird with long legs and a long, curved bill.
examples: An ibis waded in the marsh.
The ibis probes the mud with its curved bill.
White ibises nest in the trees.
